hints.title: Focusing on Boundary Characters
hints.text: A palindrome of length 3 is determined by identical outer characters and an arbitrary inner character.

hints.title: Tracking Extreme Indices
hints.text: For each of the 26 lowercase characters, find its earliest and latest occurrence indices in the string.

hints.title: Counting Distinct Middle Elements
hints.text: For each character with at least two occurrences, count distinct characters located strictly between its first and last positions.

complexity.space: O(1) auxiliary space beyond character alphabet
complexity.notes: First/last boundary index lookup across 26 lowercase English letters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all triplets takes O(N^3) time, which times out for N = 100,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bounding the search to 26 distinct outer letters reduces search space to linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should realize a length 3 palindrome is fully characterized by outer letter pair.
